verdict.rationale: The evidence points to some bulk-style capabilities: tenant-level deletion of a container tag's content through the API or console, and connectors that auto-sync many documents from Google Drive, Notion, GitHub and similar sources. Otherwise, document operations are described only as per-item list/get/update/delete, and no batch endpoint is documented. Missing for 10: explicit batch add/update/delete endpoints, bulk operations driven by metadata filters, documented limits or behavior for bulk jobs, and hands-on corroboration.
